What we supply

Equip your facility, top to bottom.

From theatre and delivery beds to diagnostics, laboratory equipment, mobility aids and consumables — we cover what a hospital, clinic or lab runs on, sourced genuine and backed by installation support.

Theatre & Delivery

Electric and hydraulic theatre beds, delivery beds and theatre lighting for surgical and maternity suites.

Ward & ICU Beds

Electric, ICU and manually adjustable hospital beds for wards and critical care units.

Diagnostics & Monitoring

ECG machines, patient monitors, ultrasound and X-ray equipment for accurate diagnosis.

Critical & Emergency Care

Dialysis machines, ventilators, defibrillators and crash carts for critical and emergency response.

Mobility & Patient Transport

Wheelchairs, walkers, crutches and stretchers to keep patients moving safely.

Laboratory & Sterilisation

Microscopes and autoclaves for laboratory diagnostics and instrument sterilisation.

Education & Training

Anatomy models and training aids for teaching hospitals and nursing schools.

Apparel & Consumables

Scrubs, gowns, caps and disposables for everyday clinical wear.

About Dexa

An indigenous medical equipment company, trusted since 2020.

Dexa Integrated Limited is a limited liability company incorporated in October 2020 under the Companies and Allied Matters Act (CAMA) Nigeria, with its registered office in Abuja, Nigeria.

We are an indigenous medical equipment/device procurement, sales, supply, installation and training company, and sole distributors in Nigeria for several manufacturers including Himedia, Comen and Winfo.

IncorporatedOctober 2020 · CAMA Nigeria
HeadquarteredJabi, Abuja
Sole distributor forHimedia, Comen & Winfo
SupportInstallation, training & maintenance
Vision

To be a renowned brand and company of choice for the sales and distribution of medical and pharmaceutical supplies in Nigeria.

Mission

Through strategic partnerships and collaborations across the industry, we aim to achieve seamless procurement of products and undertake targeted marketing initiatives while ensuring we render service with efficiency and professionalism.
